item.title: Malaysian Woman Reunited With Family After 18 Years Stranded in Lombok
item.description: SEPANG, Feb 15 — A Malaysian woman who had been separated from her family for 18 years has safely returned home with her daughter after being repatriated from Lombok, Indonesia, through Kuala Lumpur International Airport 2 (KLIA2). Norida Akmal Ayop had followed her Indonesian husband to Lombok nearly two decades ago and settled there.
